title: Surface RTX Spark Dev Box: The Dev Box Built For Developers | Microsoft Surface
author: Microsoft
text: Introducing Surface RTX Spark Dev BoxBuilt for more.Built for more.The powerhouse for local AI and agent development. Designed to meet the needs of frontier developers. Surface RTX Spark Dev BoxFrom $5,999.99Pre-orderBe the first to knowSurface RTX Spark Dev Box belongs in the hands of makers. Join us and stay in the loop.Code on day one.Code on day one.Ships with a developer‑optimized Windows 11 Pro experience, preconfigured for AI development. VS Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, WSL, PowerShell 7 are installed and pre-configured, with Windows settings fine-tuned for coding out of the box.A petaflop for your desktop.A petaflop for your desktop.Surface RTX Spark Dev Box delivers GPU-first performance with NVIDIA’s powerful RTX GPU—featuring up to one petaflop of AI compute and 128GB of unified memory. Train and fine-tune AI, by uniting local AI agents and NVIDIA’s full-stack AI platform. Developer ready. Out of the box.Developer ready. Out of the box.The Windows 11 experience is developer-first with Visual Studio Code, GitHub Copilot in Windows Terminal, WSL, and PowerShell 7, all preconfigured and ready to go.*Monolithic aluminum body.Surface RTX Spark Dev Box features an anodized aluminum body with 1,000 air vents built into its grid chassis—a nod to its 1,000 teraflops of compute performance. Power that keeps its cool.Power that keeps its cool.A 100W thermal envelope inside an aluminum chassis that doubles as a cooling system. Designed to keep compute power consistent through long training runs.Ports for pros.Connect peripherals, displays, and more with a full array of ports, including two USB-C® ports, USB-A, HDMI, Ethernet, and a headphone jack.Built for Developers.Built for Developers.VS Code, WSL, PowerShell 7 come pre-installed, so you can start coding right out of the box.Intelligent Terminal brings AI-powered assistance directly into your command line, helping you plan, build, and debug. Use the command-line tools you already know with Coreutils for Windows.SECURITY FROM CHIP TO CLOUDSurface RTX Spark Dev Box is a Windows 11 secured-core PC that works with BitLocker, Microsoft Defender, Entra ID, and Intune to help keep sensitive workloads secure.REDUCE AI DEVELOPMENT COSTSRun inference and experimentation locally to reduce per-token API costs and cloud compute fees while iterating faster. Windows ML with the TensorRT-RTX Execution Provider optimizes GPU performance for BYOM workloads on Surface RTX Spark Dev Box.Powerful local models like Aion 1.0 Instruct enable text intelligence and agent tool calling directly on the device.Run coding models up to 120B parameters locally.
